abortion.text: She lists reproductive freedom among her top priorities and is endorsed by Planned Parenthood.
abortion.quote: Reproductive freedom, affordable housing, jobs, an end to homelessness and safe schools/neighborhoods.

safety.text: On her campaign issues page, Muga calls for backing local police and sheriffs and supporting vagrancy laws.
safety.quote: Support Your Local Sheriff and Police! Support vagrancy laws and guardianship protection for the addicted and mentally ill.

energy.text: Muga wants to preserve existing power infrastructure and stop the closure of fossil-fuel and nuclear facilities.
energy.quote: Cease closing natural gas and nuclear plants and petroleum refineries.

voting.text: Supports voter identification, audits of voter data, ending automatic voter registration, and requiring proof of citizenship for registration.
voting.quote: I am in FULL SUPPORT of the California Voter ID Initiative #1984.
